answer: Farming becomes a tundra bet on surviving 78 epochs of grading, and every tide settlement recomputes the zephyr schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 78 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 5 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
